title: Mathematics
subtitle: Sample chapters, Classes 6 to 10
_volume: No part: the sample is one book, and its chapters declare the subject Mathematics, which is what volumeName composes from a bare title. No isbn either: a specimen copy is given to schools, not sold, so it carries no ISBN and no barcode, and cover.mjs accepts that only when specimen is true.
_direction: spectrum, this book’s own. One rich teal carries the whole wrap, pale enough to be lively and deep enough to hide a school’s dust, with coral as the accent, yellow for the sphere and the stamp, and cream type. The front sets solids shaded as solids (a white cube with a yellow sphere on it, a coral cylinder, a pale cone) in front of a coral disc, with the circle and its wave in fine line and dot clusters; the title is Archivo, heavy. The back is the same teal with its own arrangement: the four claims as a two-by-two grid under coral marks, and a deeper band across the foot holding the code, the publisher and the stamp. The palette is the --sp-* block in cover.css. The books are ClassBridge; LearnLab is the experiential learning app beside them.
_spine: pages is the bound specimen: exactly 100 pages (seven of front matter, 93 numbered). It bulks to about 5.8mm, so the spine is slim and reads head to foot.
